text.tspan: Of 20 states with at least $0.5M in declared party spend, Democratic-declared
advertisers outspent Republican-declared ones in 13 and were outspent in 7
Share of single-state Google ad spend by declared candidates and party committees, top 200 advertisers.
Grey: under $0.5M combined declared spend. Blue: mostly Democratic; red: mostly Republican.
Source: Google Political Ads Transparency Report via BigQuery (bigquery-public-data.google_political_ads).
US advertisers, Google ads only. Weekly spend; incomplete current week excluded.
Not shown: Alaska: $0.0M Democratic, $0.2M Republican; Hawaii: $0.0M Democratic, $0.0M Republican.
